config.title: Auto-plan
config.scopeProject: Selected project — from tomorrow (the past is frozen).
config.scopeGlobal: All projects — from tomorrow (the past is frozen).

preserveDesc.none: Replans the whole future of the scope, including manual.
preserveDesc.manual_autosplit: Replaces only auto-plan allocations; manual and auto-split are kept.
preserveDesc.manual: Replaces auto-plan and auto-split; keeps manual only.

assignDesc.suggest: Proposes the best-fit person (skill + capacity); you can change it in the preview before applying.
assignDesc.auto: Assigns the best-fit person without asking; you confirm on apply.

strategyDesc.asap: Places every task at the earliest slot, arbitrated by priority/urgency/skill.
strategyDesc.deadline_aware: Adds a corrective pass that tries to shift lower-priority slack ahead of tasks missing their deadline. Only kept if it strictly reduces total lateness — otherwise the as-soon-as-possible plan is used.

concentrationDesc.focus: Strongly favors reusing the same people across a project's tasks — fewer hand-offs.
concentrationDesc.balanced: Default: groups tasks by shared skill/parent and widens the core team only when coverage is insufficient.
concentrationDesc.spread: Safety valve: evaluates every task on its own, no grouping — restores the historical behavior.
